subject.title: Fix silent provider-error retry after prior side effects

question: Should this PR be refreshed and accepted as the canonical fix for the empty provider-error retry blocker, including the optional currentAttemptReplayMetadata harness contract and server_error retry-before-failover ordering?
rationale: The code shape looks like the right layer, but retry/session/message delivery semantics and the SDK-exported attempt result field are compatibility-sensitive choices that automation should not accept without maintainer intent and stronger proof.
